name: Ichinomiya (Kumamoto, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ichinomiya town emblem in white: an outlined ring crossed by a horizontal bar, with a pointed top.
history: Flag of the former town of Ichinomiya in Kumamoto Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-02-11. Flag and emblem were adopted on 15 November 1981.

features.role: Ichinomiya town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a horizontal bar, with a pointed top
